lines.ruling: Ruling: scope; same objection as the earlier rulings (boxes G and J). f8949 p. 1, box G: "Short-term transactions reported on Form(s) 1099-DA showing basis was reported to the IRS"; i8949 p. 8, code B. The helper is true only for boxes A and D because boxes G to L are refused at the transaction: sales.one refuses when sales.digital ("Digital asset box G–L"), and the refusal reaches every Schedule D total and Form 1040 line 7a (fixture sales.refuse.digital.G). Within boxes A to F the condition reads as the instructions do. The R3 restructuring of the sales questions changed the glossary text, not this line. Project stands on the English.

Ruling: scope; same objection as the earlier rulings (boxes G and J). i8949 p. 8, code B: "Correct the error by entering an adjustment in column (g)". The code B part is gated on boxes A and D because boxes G to L are refused at the transaction: sales.one refuses when sales.digital ("Digital asset box G–L"), and the refusal reaches every Schedule D total and Form 1040 line 7a (fixture sales.refuse.digital.G); the sum of the code B correction and the code W wash-sale loss is the net adjustment the model accepts. Project stands on the English.
